title: Columbine
summary: COLUMBINE, adjective Like or pertaining to a pigeon or dove; of a dove-color, or like the neck of a dove. COLUMBINE, noun Aquilegia, a genus of plants of several species. The Thalictrum or meadow-rue

inlines.v: COLUMBINE, adjective Like or pertaining to a pigeon or dove; of a dove-color, or like the neck of a dove. COLUMBINE, noun Aquilegia, a genus of plants of several species. The Thalictrum or meadow-rue is also called feathered columbine
